metadata.case_name: SEN HEM PRATAP v. HANG YUE ENGINEERING LTD

injuries.description: A small metallic foreign body was found over his right cornea with removal done.
source: A small metallic foreign body was found over his right cornea with removal done.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

injuries.description: he sustained right eye injury and a permanent scar was left at his right eye pupil.
source: he sustained right eye injury and a permanent scar was left at his right eye pupil.

they conducted an examination on Pratap on 9 November 2010 and found that there were 3 non-axial corneal scars at the cornea of the right eye and thus Pratap must have suffered from more than one episodes of foreign body lodging onto the cornea in the past.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of eye or orbit

manifestations.description: Pain and burning sensation at his right eye
Insomnia (he could not sleep well at night because of the pain and burning sensation)
Visual power is very poor; he has to wear spectacles now or he is unable to read the number of the bus route even the bus is right in front of him
left eye anterior uveitis causing epiphora, photophobia and blurred vision (unrelated to the Accident)

treatments_received: removal of foreign body from right cornea
referral to Tuen Mun Eye Centre
medical and follow-up sessions (15 sessions between 13 November 2008 and 7 September 2009)

losses.description: Permanent scar left at his right eye pupil
